# Instruments: Mallet percussion

A note's `pitch` uses the **MIDI pitch (60 = middle C)**. Latest list: `muser instruments --family mallet`.

| instrument | Recommended range | Polyphony | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mallet.marimba` | 45–96 | 12 | Marimba: warm and woody; suited to melodies and arpeggios |
| `mallet.xylophone` | 65–108 | 12 | Xylophone: bright and short |
| `mallet.vibraphone` | 53–89 | 12 | Vibraphone: metallic with a long tail; common in jazz and lo-fi |
| `mallet.glockenspiel` | 79–108 | 12 | Glockenspiel: high, clear bell tones |
| `mallet.celesta` | 60–108 | 12 | Celesta: soft bell tones, dreamy |
| `mallet.kalimba` | 60–88 | 12 | Kalimba (thumb piano): crisp and gentle |
| `mallet.steel_pan` | 60–84 | 12 | Steel pan: metallic Caribbean sound |
| `mallet.tubular_bells` | 60–77 | 8 | Tubular bells: solemn bell tones with a long tail |

## Adjustable parameters (instrument_params)

Override the sound of the chosen instrument/preset; write only the items you want to change, the rest stay as they are. `muser instruments <name>` shows the preset's current values.

| Parameter | Range | Automation | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decay` | 0.05 – 60 s | next note | Natural decay time after the strike (middle C) |
| `release` | 0.01 – 60 s | next note | Damping time after release (vibraphone/celesta/tubular bells have dampers) |
| `softness` | 1 – 8 | next note | Mallet hardness: 1 hard and bright; 4-8 soft and round |
| `strike_position` | 0 – 1 | next note | Strike position. 0.5 is the center (fullest); toward the edge has more overtones |
| `motor_rate` | 0 – 16 Hz | ✓ | Vibraphone motor speed (tremolo rate), 0 = off |
| `motor_depth` | 0 – 1 | ✓ | Vibraphone motor tremolo depth |

Automation column: ✓ = notes already sounding follow immediately; next note = affects only notes that start afterward; — = cannot be automated. See [automation.md](../automation.md).

### Tuning examples

- Soft-mallet marimba with long ring

  ```json
  { "instrument": "mallet.marimba", "instrument_params": {"softness": 5, "decay": 3.0} }
  ```

- Vibraphone with the motor vibrato on

  ```json
  { "instrument": "mallet.vibraphone", "instrument_params": {"motor_rate": 5, "motor_depth": 0.6} }
  ```


## Tips and common mistakes

- The sound decays naturally by itself, so a `length` that is too long does no harm; it suits arpeggios and short melodies.
- The vibraphone and tubular bells ring for a long time, and fast successive playing piles up; when you need it clean, lower the tempo or reduce the notes.
